Gillian — thanks for the note and the sample. Short answer: we prefer the portal for long term, but we support an email fallback for small or one-off vendors. A quick proposed parity test so both sides can validate ingestion:

- You upload 3 invoices via the portal (small, medium, multi-line).
- You send those same 3 invoices to ap+halcyon@redwood-invoices.com as PDF attachments (one email per invoice).
- We run PO-match and return a short ingestion report (pass / fail + one-line reason) within 48 business hours.

A couple of important notes for the CSV/templating on our side:
- PO number must be in field PO_NUMBER (case-insensitive).
- Line-level SKU or description is best for reconciliation; avoid freeform combined descriptions where possible.
- Prefer separate tax and freight fields rather than embedding them in line totals.

Can you run the parity test by EOD Friday? If portal access is easier first, PortalOps is our partner for onboarding — I've cc'd Monica and Vanessa to coordinate provisioning and field mapping.

Connor
Connor O'Brien

Gillian — welcome. A couple of practical items and a compact template to speed ingestion. We're attaching a compact Excel with the exact headers our parser expects; we've also pasted the minimal CSV schema below so you can validate quickly without opening Excel.

Minimal compact schema (CSV / portal field mapping):
- INVOICE_NUMBER (required)
- INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
- PO_NUMBER (required)
- VENDOR_NAME
- VENDOR_ADDRESS_LINE1
- LINE_NUMBER (1..n)
- ITEM_DESCRIPTION
- QUANTITY
- UNIT_PRICE
- LINE_TAX
- LINE_TOTAL (calculated ok, but best to include)
- INVOICE_TOTAL
- CURRENCY (USD)

PO stamping: If you include a PO_NUMBER and it matches an open PO in our system, we stamp the invoice and trigger auto-routing. If the PO is missing, the invoice goes into exception queue and requires manual review (this slows payment).

Portal upload tips: filename convention = vendorname_invoice_YYYYMMDD.pdf (helps for dedupe). For the email fallback, subject line should contain the PO like: "PO 12345 — Halcyon Invoice 20270720" and send to ap+halcyon@redwood-invoices.com.

Attached: compact_invoice_example.xlsx (contains example rows).

We will provision a portal invite by Thursday morning. If you prefer a support token for API/SFTP after the test, PortalOps can help — cc'd support@portalops.com.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior AP Integrations Manager, Redwood Inference
